Initial release of agent-browser-core skill for the agent-browser CLI.

- Provides AI-friendly web automation via CLI, with Rust-based speed and Node.js fallback.
- Supports snapshots, refs, and structured commands for deterministic agent control.
- Includes operational guardrails, safety defaults, and security best practices.
- Documentation covers setup, command details, troubleshooting, and workflow recommendations.
- Not intended as a full SDK or for complex media uploads.
